# WO-360: Every backend test in tests/grok blocks the network (guard)
Status: queued (pre-approved; start when a WIP slot frees, see Order; note it on GROK_BOARD.md first)
Vendor: grok
Agent: test-writer (Ethan Brandt)
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via GROK_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Kind: tests
Target release: 0.4
Source: in-house 0.4 groundwork batch 2026-11-09, CLAUDE-G-006 (in-house offline until about Nov 14; vendors keep working the queue)
Worktree: `.vendor-wt/wo-360` on `vendor/wo-360` from main
Tracker: issue pending (in-house syncs freemyid-pm)

## Goal
Add a repository-reading test that opens each `tests/grok/test_gk_*.py` file that imports from `freemyid.engine`, `freemyid.submitters`, `freemyid.scheduler`, `freemyid.notify`, `freemyid.setup_config` or `freemyid.cli_json` and checks it blocks sockets (an autouse fixture or a shared conftest), uses no `subprocess` without a fake, and no `/tmp` literal.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. Lists the offending file and line when a test fails the rule.
2. Existing grok tests that fail the rule are reported in VENDOR_STATUS.md, not edited here.
3. Windows-safe: reads files as UTF-8 with `pathlib`.
4. Runs in under a second.

**Limits (every Grok WO, CLAUDE-G-004):** offline only. No network, credentials, git or gh, installs, or running the real app against real sites or a real mailbox; never read anything outside the repo. Fake people only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Tests pass on Windows too (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`). Check `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/`, `tests/grok/` and the in-house `tests/test_*.py` first; don't duplicate a guard.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- `tests/grok/test_gk_backend_offline_guard.py`
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Out of scope / do not touch
Every file not listed above. In particular: the front end, the security core and the contracts (see the code rules), `web/`, `packaging/`, `.github/`, `tools/`, `.grok/`, `docs/vendor/grok-team/`, other Grok WOs' files, and Codex's lane (`engine/{matcher,nicknames,exposure,exposure_score,listing_finder,search_engines,law_matrix,letters,htmlsel}.py`, `monitor.py`, `exposure_models.py`, `checklists.py`, `checklist_state.py`, `doctor.py`, `tests/codex/`, `docs/dev/`, `docs/i18n/`).

## Required checks (run in the worktree)
- `PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/grok/test_gk_backend_offline_guard.py`
- `../../.venv/bin/ruff check tests/grok`
- Browser tests skipped in the sandbox do not count as passing; say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md.

## Check-in plan
Deliver into the worktree (nothing merges until in-house review): VENDOR_STATUS.md complete (Done, Next, Questions, How to test with exact counts, findings with file:line), then a GROK-NNN message in `docs/vendor/GROK_TO_CLAUDE.md` citing the WO and its tracker issue. Delivery lead reviews before the PM reports it delivered.
